tagline: Nordic banking leader providing comprehensive financial solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: The CET1 Ratio is the primary measure of financial strength for a bank, key in the regulated financial sector. Nordea maintains a ratio of 17.45%, well above regulatory minima, reflecting strong resilience capacity.

kpis.name: Common Equity Tier 1 Ratio (CET1)
kpis.explanation: Measures the bank's financial strength using its highest-quality capital.
kpis.description: The CET1 ratio is a key indicator of financial resilience. It stands at 17.45% as of June 30, 2024, showing a steady increase since end-2023.
kpis.signal: Very strong capital ratio, well above regulatory minimums.

kpis.name: Total Capital Ratio
kpis.explanation: Percentage of total capital relative to risk-weighted assets.
kpis.description: The total capital ratio measures the bank's ability to absorb losses. It reached 22.97% in Q2 2024.
kpis.signal: High level of total capitalization, reflecting prudent management.

kpis.name: Tier 1 Ratio
kpis.explanation: Measures financial strength by including core and additional tier 1 capital.
kpis.description: The Tier 1 ratio stands at 19.81% as of June 30, 2024, showing consistent improvement since September 2023.
kpis.signal: Continuous improvement in Tier 1 ratio, indicating balance sheet strengthening.

kpis.name: Leverage Ratio
kpis.explanation: Measures the bank's total exposure relative to its equity.
kpis.description: The leverage ratio stands at 4.96% as of June 30, 2024, slightly up from 4.71% one year earlier.
kpis.signal: Stable and controlled leverage ratio, reflecting managed exposure.

kpis.name: Total Risk-Weighted Exposure
kpis.explanation: Total amount of risk-weighted assets held by the bank.
kpis.description: Total risk-weighted exposure amounts to EUR 139.3 billion as of June 30, 2024, slightly down from EUR 140.9 billion one year earlier.
kpis.signal: Slight decline in risk exposure, indicating prudent management.

kpis.name: Common Equity Tier 1 Capital (CET1)
kpis.explanation: Amount of high-quality capital held by the bank.
kpis.description: CET1 capital amounts to EUR 24.3 billion as of June 30, 2024, up from EUR 23.0 billion one year earlier.
kpis.signal: Growth in equity capital, strengthening financial resilience.

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of 7.1738 DKK in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of 3.268 Bn DKK in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last four fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Proportion of net income distributed as dividends: 67.5% in the latest year.

risks.title: Geopolitical conflicts and Nordic recession
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned at the beginning of the section with strong language ('could trigger'), described as a major scenario deviation factor. Increasing trend (new 2026 context). Geopolitical category carries high weight for a Nordic bank.

risks.title: Equity market correction and AI valuations
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly mentioned early in risk factors with moderate language ('could depress'). Emerging trend (growing concerns over AI valuations). Impact on corporate and consumer confidence.

risks.title: Credit risk and insufficient provisions
risks.score_rationale: Central risk in the report with significant adjustments (EUR 76m Q1 2026). Technical but revealing language ('expected credit losses not yet adequately captured'). Increasing trend (revised approach, full deployment of judgmental provisions). Credit category carries high weight.

risks.title: Exposure to Russian counterparties
risks.score_rationale: Risk specifically mentioned with ongoing monitoring ('closely monitor and assess'). Direct exposure reduced (less than EUR 20m) but tense geopolitical context. Stable but persistent trend.

risks.title: Deterioration of the residential real estate market
risks.score_rationale: Implicit risk in adverse scenarios with falling property prices (down to -6.1% in Denmark). Large mortgage loan portfolio (EUR 141 billion). Increasing trend (40% probability of adverse scenario).

risks.title: Rising unemployment in Finland
risks.score_rationale: Region-specific risk with high unemployment rate (11.7% in adverse scenario). Significant Finnish portfolio (EUR 580m provisions). Stable but structurally high trend.

risks.title: Sectoral concentration in real estate
risks.score_rationale: Highly concentrated real estate portfolio (EUR 45.9 billion, 15% of total). Neutral language but significant exposure. Stable but structural trend.
